dialogues.jp: さて、今日も元気に、飯でも食うか。
dialogues.en: Now then, time to enjoy lunch.
dialogues.text: Now then, time to enjoy lunch.

dialogues.jp:
日々の中で、この時が一番充実しているように
思える。
dialogues.en: In my opinion, this is the most enjoyable time of every day.
dialogues.text: In my opinion, this is the most enjoyable time of every day.

dialogues.jp:
何と言っても、食欲は人間の三大欲求のうちの
ひとつだからな。
dialogues.en:
No matter what anyone says, gluttony is always one of the
sins every human falls prey to.
dialogues.text:
No matter what anyone says, gluttony is always one of the
sins every human falls prey to.

dialogues.jp: 大切にしなくては……。
dialogues.en: It's the most important period...
dialogues.text: It's the most important period...

dialogues.jp: それにはやはり、食料調達が最優先だ。
dialogues.en: So of course, the type of food would also be paramount.
dialogues.text: So of course, the type of food would also be paramount.

dialogues.jp:
俺の脳は、購買部への買い物を命令し、足は戦
場の兵士のようにターゲットに向かって正確に
歩きだす。
dialogues.en:
My brain was the command center, and my feet were the
soliders heading to the battle at the stores for rations.
dialogues.text:
My brain was the command center, and my feet were the
soliders heading to the battle at the stores for rations.

dialogues.jp: しかし、前方に妙な風景を発見する。
dialogues.en:
But the scenery in front of me was enough to stop me in my
tracks.
dialogues.text:
But the scenery in front of me was enough to stop me in my
tracks.

dialogues.jp: 環とさくらが、親しげに話をしている。
dialogues.en:
It was Tamaki and Sakura, talking as if they were the best
of friends.
dialogues.text:
It was Tamaki and Sakura, talking as if they were the best
of friends.

dialogues.jp: あの二人、いつの間にか仲良くなってたなんて。
dialogues.en: When did those two get this close?
dialogues.text: When did those two get this close?

dialogues.jp:
環もさくらも転校生同士、色々と不安もあった
のだろう。
dialogues.en:
I suppose both of them being transfer students gives them a
sense of understanding with each other.
dialogues.text:
I suppose both of them being transfer students gives them a
sense of understanding with each other.

dialogues.jp:
さくらも巫女に対して興味を持っているし、共
鳴する部分もあるのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention Sakura's interest in Miko... she probably
sympathizes with Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
Not to mention Sakura's interest in Miko... she probably
sympathizes with Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 二人とも、ちょっと変わってるからな。
dialogues.en: The two of them seem to have changed a little.
dialogues.text: The two of them seem to have changed a little.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、購買部へ直行しようかとも思ったが、
おもしろそうなので、声を掛けることにした。
dialogues.en:
With that weird sight in front of me, I forgot about my
original battle plan, and called out to them.
dialogues.text:
With that weird sight in front of me, I forgot about my
original battle plan, and called out to them.

dialogues.jp: 「よっ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お兄ちゃ〜ん！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, onii-chaaan!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, onii-chaaan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「何やってるんだ、こんなところで」
dialogues.en: "What're you two doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What're you two doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いま、さくら様のうたまる様を抱かせてもらっ
　てるんです」
dialogues.en: "I am holding Sakura-san's Utamaru-san right now."
dialogues.text: "I am holding Sakura-san's Utamaru-san right now."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うたまる様？」
dialogues.en: "Utamaru-san?"
dialogues.text: "Utamaru-san?"

dialogues.jp:
見ると、環の腕の中で気持ち良さそうに懐いて
いるうたまるがいる。
dialogues.en:
I glanced at the seemingly-satisfied Utamaru, nestling in
Tamaki's chest.
dialogues.text:
I glanced at the seemingly-satisfied Utamaru, nestling in
Tamaki's chest.

dialogues.jp: 「おいおい、さくら。学校に猫はまずいだろ」
dialogues.en:
"Oy oy, Sakura. You're not supposed to bring pets into
school."
dialogues.text:
"Oy oy, Sakura. You're not supposed to bring pets into
school."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫。授業になったらちゃんと家に帰るか
　らさ」
dialogues.en: "It's okay! He goes home when I go for lessons."
dialogues.text: "It's okay! He goes home when I go for lessons."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まったく……」
dialogues.en: "Sigh..."
dialogues.text: "Sigh..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、猫はかわいいですね。顔を洗う仕
　草とか、可愛すぎます！」
dialogues.en:
"Cats are so cute... even the way they wash their face is
too much to bear!"
dialogues.text:
"Cats are so cute... even the way they wash their face is
too much to bear!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でしょ？　でしょ？　ボクはやっぱり犬より
　猫が好き！」
dialogues.en: "Isn't it, isn't it? I like them so much better than dogs!"
dialogues.text: "Isn't it, isn't it? I like them so much better than dogs!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの｛わがまま／我侭｝なところがいいんですよね」
dialogues.en: "It's independence and wilfulness is also attractive."
dialogues.text: "It's independence and wilfulness is also attractive."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だにゃ。懐いてきたかと思うとすぐそっぽ向
　くし。いつ帰ってくるかわからないところも」
dialogues.en:
"Uh huh! It really likes your chest. I don't know when he'd
come out of there."
dialogues.text:
"Uh huh! It really likes your chest. I don't know when he'd
come out of there."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「たまに帰ってきて甘えてくれると、もう何で
　もやってあげたくなっちゃう」
dialogues.en:
"It should come out once in a while, but I don't mind
keeping him there forever otherwise."
dialogues.text:
"It should come out once in a while, but I don't mind
keeping him there forever otherwise."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いいね。環ちゃんは猫の心得を知ってるね！」
dialogues.en: "Nice, you really understand a cat's heart!"
dialogues.text: "Nice, you really understand a cat's heart!"

dialogues.jp: 猫については、二人はかなり意見が合うらしい。
dialogues.en: It seems their opinion on cats are similar as well.
dialogues.text: It seems their opinion on cats are similar as well.

dialogues.jp: いつもは冷静な環が、熱っぽく話をしている。
dialogues.en:
The usually cool and calm Tamaki was speaking with
surprising passion.
dialogues.text:
The usually cool and calm Tamaki was speaking with
surprising passion.

dialogues.jp:
それより、俺は、そいつがどうやって顔を洗う
のかを教えて欲しい。
dialogues.en:
If I learn how to wash my face like that cat does, would
Tamaki say that about me too?
dialogues.text:
If I learn how to wash my face like that cat does, would
Tamaki say that about me too?

dialogues.jp: 「環は猫飼ったことあるの？」
dialogues.en: "Have you raised cats before, Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Have you raised cats before, Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「小学校の頃、三毛猫を飼っていたのですが、
　寿命で……。それ以来、飼えないんです」
dialogues.en:
"During grade school, I took in a cute little three-coloured
cat, but it didn't live long... after that, no."
dialogues.text:
"During grade school, I took in a cute little three-coloured
cat, but it didn't live long... after that, no."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だから、今はこうやって人のお家の猫でも可
　愛らしく思えて仕方がないんです」
dialogues.en:
"So, I couldn't imagine I'd find such a cute cat again to
fawn over."
dialogues.text:
"So, I couldn't imagine I'd find such a cute cat again to
fawn over."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん。そんなもんかね」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, so that's how it is..."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, so that's how it is..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「冬なんかさ、うたまるが布団に入ってくると
　あったかいんだよね。電気あんかみたいで」
dialogues.en:
"During winter, Utamaru would crawl under the futon with me
and warm both of us up~"
dialogues.text:
"During winter, Utamaru would crawl under the futon with me
and warm both of us up~"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう。あれは病みつきですよね」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes, I could see myself getting addicted to that."
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes, I could see myself getting addicted to that."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「さくら様は幸せですね。うたまる様といつも
　一緒で」
dialogues.en:
"Sakura-san is really lucky, to be with Utamaru-san all the
time."
dialogues.text:
"Sakura-san is really lucky, to be with Utamaru-san all the
time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「環ちゃんさえ嫌じゃなければ、たまに神社に
　行かせるよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, if you don't mind, I'd drop by often at the shrine."
dialogues.text: "Well, if you don't mind, I'd drop by often at the shrine."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当？　すごく嬉しい！」
dialogues.en: "Really? That would be fantastic!"
dialogues.text: "Really? That would be fantastic!"

dialogues.jp: 環がこんなに感情を｛あら／顕｝わにするのは珍しい。
dialogues.en: Seeing this side of Tamaki manifesting was a rare sight.
dialogues.text: Seeing this side of Tamaki manifesting was a rare sight.

dialogues.jp: 案外、子供っぽいところもあるんだな。
dialogues.en: She's acting so much like... a kid.
dialogues.text: She's acting so much like... a kid.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は、猫は……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, how do you feel about cats?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, how do you feel about cats?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ま、別に嫌いじゃないけどな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I don't hate them."
dialogues.text: "Well, I don't hate them."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「たまにうたまるが行くと、かわいがってくれ
　るよね」
dialogues.en:
"Whenver I go out with Utamaru, everyone always fawns over
him."
dialogues.text:
"Whenver I go out with Utamaru, everyone always fawns over
him."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「へえ、そうですか」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, really?"
dialogues.text: "Hehe, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「猫好きに悪い人はいないね」
dialogues.en: "There's no such thing as an evil person who likes cats!"
dialogues.text: "There's no such thing as an evil person who likes cats!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それは、絶対言えますよね」
dialogues.en: "That is indeed, the absolute truth."
dialogues.text: "That is indeed, the absolute truth."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ほんと、意外なところで環ちゃんと共通点が
　見つかって、ボク、嬉しいよ」
dialogues.en:
"We really found something uncommon to be similar in. I'm
glad for that!"
dialogues.text:
"We really found something uncommon to be similar in. I'm
glad for that!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「私もです。あ、じゃあ、うたまる様をお返し
　します」
dialogues.en: "The feeling is mutual. Ah, I'd return Utamaru-san now."
dialogues.text: "The feeling is mutual. Ah, I'd return Utamaru-san now."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当に、ちっちゃくて抱き心地よかったです」
dialogues.en:
"It was really nice to have something that tiny snuggling up
to me."
dialogues.text:
"It was really nice to have something that tiny snuggling up
to me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「また、いつでも言ってね。じゃ、お兄ちゃん
　またね」
dialogues.en: "Then, till next time! See you too, onii-chan!"
dialogues.text: "Then, till next time! See you too, onii-chan!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらはうたまるを頭にのせて、自分の教室へ
と帰っていった。
dialogues.en:
Placing Utamaru on her head, Sakura headed back to her
classroom.
dialogues.text:
Placing Utamaru on her head, Sakura headed back to her
classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「さくら様って、いい方ですね」
dialogues.en: "Sakura-san is really nice."
dialogues.text: "Sakura-san is really nice."

dialogues.jp:
環は友達ができた嬉しさからか、顔がいつもよ
り興奮しているように見える。
dialogues.en:
After the glow of making a new friend, her unusually excited
demeanour remained.
dialogues.text:
After the glow of making a new friend, her unusually excited
demeanour remained.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Mmhmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmhmm."

dialogues.jp:
環の嬉しそうな顔を見るのは、俺にとっても嬉
しい。
dialogues.en: Seeing her happy face lifted my own spirits, too.
dialogues.text: Seeing her happy face lifted my own spirits, too.

dialogues.jp: 「よかったな」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
俺も、環の子供っぽい一面を発見できて、なん
だか嬉しい気分だ。
dialogues.en:
Seeing her more outgoing and less reserved gave me a good
feeling, too.
dialogues.text:
Seeing her more outgoing and less reserved gave me a good
feeling, too.

dialogues.jp:
俺と環は、猫の話の続きをしながら、購買へ向
かった。
dialogues.en:
We spent the rest of the walk to the food stores, talking
about cats.
dialogues.text:
We spent the rest of the walk to the food stores, talking
about cats.

dialogues.jp: ◆ねこ談義◆
dialogues.en: ◆All About Cats?◆
dialogues.text: ◆All About Cats?◆

dialogues.jp:
昼を買いに購買部へ行こうとすると、環とさく
らが親しげに話をしている。
dialogues.en:
While walking to the stores to buy lunch, I euncountered
Tamaki and Sakura.
dialogues.text:
While walking to the stores to buy lunch, I euncountered
Tamaki and Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
何の話をしているのか尋ねると、二人とも猫の
話で盛り上がっていた。
dialogues.en:
They were apparently talking about their joint admiration
for cats.
dialogues.text:
They were apparently talking about their joint admiration
for cats.

dialogues.jp: どうやら、ねこ好きらしい。
dialogues.en: They sure like cats a lot.
dialogues.text: They sure like cats a lot.
